description:
Unlock the agent's wallet to enable transactions.
If no wallet ID is provided, unlocks the active wallet.
Omit password when the server has AIBTC_WALLET_PASSWORD_FILE or AIBTC_WALLET_PASSWORD set: the server reads it, so it never enters the conversation.
The configured password only unlocks the wallet that was active when the server started, and that unlock keeps the current session's spend budget.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

password.description: Wallet password - WARNING: sensitive value. Omit it to use AIBTC_WALLET_PASSWORD_FILE / AIBTC_WALLET_PASSWORD from the server's environment.

walletId.description: Wallet ID to unlock (uses active wallet if not specified)

name: wallet_unlock
